sources.shortCitation: IMDb, “René Nazelles” — Name entry nm0623410
sources.fullCitation: IMDb. “René Nazelles.” Name entry nm0623410.
sources.researchNote: IMDb gives his dates as 1888–1975. This is corroborated by Encyclopédisque, which records his name as René Cailleteau, and by Éliane Daphy’s identification record “René Cailleteau dit René Nazelles (1888–1975) parolier”. The BnF authority heading still reads (18..-19..) and has not been revised.
sources.title: IMDb name entry nm0623410 — René Nazelles
sources.creator: IMDb
